Black & White series · DRX

Dragons Exalted

Released August 15, 2012 · 128 cards

Expanded

Dragons Exalted is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on August 15, 2012. Its main set has 124 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (128 in total). It includes 122 Pokémon, 4 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

30 illustrators worked on Dragons Exalted. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (14), Kagemaru Himeno (8), Kouki Saitou (8), Masakazu Fukuda (8), Akira Komayama (7), Ryo Ueda (7), Eske Yoshinob (6), Naoki Saito (6).
